title: Geometry Unit 3 Pretest
purpose: Diagnostic assessment for prior knowledge, readiness, and acceleration eligibility.

primaryStandards.description: I can prove and apply triangle relationships and theorems in mathematical and real-world problems.
I can prove triangle congruence or similarity using valid triangle criteria.
I can justify triangle congruence criteria using rigid transformations.
I can prove and apply relationships and theorems about parallelograms.
I can prove and apply relationships and theorems about trapezoids.
